message: The invoice line period at {.} ends at {/BT-135} and starts at {/BT-134}; a period does not end before it starts.
note: The statement is the one the 2017 edition makes; this edition addresses it differently, because the path of a term it names is not a path of that edition. The rule is written out here rather than taken over from the pack of that edition for exactly that reason.

message: The document level charge or tax amount (BT-99) is missing: nothing stands at {@/BT-99}.
note: The 2017 edition asked the same of a group that carried charges alone; the group of this edition carries non-VAT taxes as well and the term is named after both.

message: The document level charge or tax VAT category code (BT-102) is missing: nothing stands at {@/BT-102}.
note: Against the 2017 edition the statement is the same and the group it is about now carries non-VAT taxes as well.

message: The document level charge or tax at {.} states no reason: neither a reason text (BT-104) nor a charge reason code (BT-105) is there.
note: Against the 2017 edition the two terms are the same and the group they are about now carries non-VAT taxes as well.

message: The invoice line charge or tax amount (BT-141) is missing: nothing stands at {@/BT-141}.
note: Against the 2017 edition the statement is the same and the group it is about now carries non-VAT taxes as well.

message: The invoice line charge or tax at {.} states no reason: neither a reason text (BT-144) nor a charge reason code (BT-145) nor a non-VAT tax type code (BT-193) is there.
note: The 2017 edition admitted the reason text and the charge reason code; this edition admits the line-level non-VAT tax type code (BT-193) as a third way of saying what the charge or tax is.

message: The VAT breakdown at {.} is categorised "{/BT-118}" and states no VAT category tax amount (BT-117).
note: The 2017 edition asked for the tax amount in every breakdown; this edition excepts the margin scheme categories, which are the four codes clause 6.4.3.4.13 names. They are written into the rule rather than looked up, because they are a set the edition states and not a published list.

message: The payment means type code (BT-81) at {@/BT-81} is {/BT-81}, a credit transfer, and no credit transfer (BG-17) states a payment account identifier (BT-84).
note: The 2017 edition asked for the identifier wherever the credit transfer group was present; this edition asks for it wherever the payment means is a credit transfer, which UNTDID 4461 codes as 30 and a SEPA credit transfer as 58. Codes that BR-61 also names are then reported by both rules.

message: The invoice names a VAT accounting currency (BT-6) of {/BT-6} and states no invoice total VAT amount in that currency (BT-111).
note: Against the 2017 edition the two terms and the condition are the same; the term BT-111 is named after the VAT accounting currency in this edition.

message: The item attribute at {.} is incomplete: an attribute carries a name (BT-160) or an attribute code (BT-211), and a value (BT-161).
note: The 2017 edition asked for the name and the value; this edition admits the new attribute code (BT-211) in place of the name.

undecided.message: the invoice line at {.} states a negative net amount (BT-131) and the item price base quantity (BT-149) {/BG-29/BT-149}, so it has no priced quantity to weigh its allowances against

message: The invoice line at {.} states the negative net amount (BT-131) {/BT-131} with the quantity (BT-129) {/BT-129}: a negative line amount is either an invoice for a negative quantity or a line whose allowances (BT-136) outweigh its charges (BT-141) and its priced quantity.
note: The price base quantity (BT-149) divides the product of the net price and the quantity; a line that states none is priced per one unit, which is what the edition says an absent base quantity means. A base quantity of zero, which the edition admits, leaves a line with a negative net amount and a quantity that is not negative undecided: the rule reports that it was not decided for that line rather than holding.

message: A VAT breakdown is categorised "K" (intra-community supply), and the invoice states no payment account identifier (BT-84).
note: The edition states the condition as an intra-community transaction, and the statement of the invoice that it is one is the category of its VAT breakdown.
